newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see some late soymeal trade.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see some late soymeal trade.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some late action in Argentine and Dutch soymeal this afternoon on the back of tight supplies, market sources said.

"There is little unsold material on vessels arriving into Europe the coming weeks and European crushers are not yet running at full capacity as North American beans arrived later than usual, causing tightness for prompt material," one broker said.
Otherwise the market remained dull despite a weaker dollar.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets tarded $4 up from Friday at $282 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Dutch high protein soymeal pellets changed haands at $325 a tonne fob Rotterdam for Week 48 delivery, up $3 from Friday, and Jan at $302 a tonne fob.
Dutch 44/7 soymeal traded at $286 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
